mechanics.claim: Aurora dashes backward when casting E and is locked out of actions during the dash.
mechanics.quote: '''Aurora''' is locked out of using all abilities, summoner spells, and item actives during the dash.

mechanics.claim: If grounded or rooted, Aurora does not dash backward but can still cast the ability (and deal its damage).
mechanics.quote: While {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}, ''The Weirding'' can be cast but '''Aurora''' will not {{tip|dash}}.
